MCP server entry point.description: Starts the Mason MCP stdio server that exposes all tools to AI assistants

drift detection CLI.description: Checks relevant committed map changes and source coverage, reporting local edits and verification failures separately; map-only and unrelated commits stay current.

legacy CLI migration shim.description: Prints a migration message for users who still invoke the removed standalone mason CLI

git history analysis.description: Analyzer that mines git history for commit conventions, hot files, and stale directories

Confluence wiki sync.description: Syncs the concept map to a Confluence space, rewriting it into product-readable language for PMs and designers

task context assembly.description: Retrieves operative accepted decisions alongside pending proposals, matching either revision while keeping content, attribution, and anchor freshness distinct. Works without a concept map and adds bounded impact and tests with explicit trust diagnostics.

team decisions log.description: Captures version 2 proposals and derives operative accepted revisions from validated history until explicit replacement or retirement. Preserves legacy uncertainty, serializes writes, and prevents proposal supersession from hiding an accepted constraint.

change impact analysis.description: get_impact: co-change history, references, and related tests for a file before editing it

LLM provider config.description: Multi-provider LLM call plumbing (claude, openai, ollama, gemini) and config stored at ~/.mason/config.json

smart file sampler.description: Selects representative files by architectural role (config, entry point, viewmodel, repository, etc.) for snapshot batches

MCP tool implementations.description: Implements all MCP tools, including map-independent decision capture, task context and impact, quickstart checks, and optional map lifecycle and verification.

concept-map snapshot storage.description: Validates and atomically stores concept maps and Map-Reduce partials; supports scoped refreshes while retaining failed verdicts for unchanged entries.

test-to-source pairing.description: Pairs test files with source files by naming convention

shared types.description: Shared analyzer/finding interfaces used across the analyzers module

git repo detection.description: Detects whether a directory is a git repository

benchmark harness.description: Evaluates read-only answers and actual code patches in baseline-versus-Mason arms. Patch tasks use isolated deterministic fixtures, held-out behavioral grading, mutation controls, configurable coding-agent adapters, saved diffs and transcripts, and human-reviewed unnecessary-intervention metrics. Offline validation is distinct from live effectiveness evidence.

Go API test fixture.description: Sample Go API project used as a fixture to test Mason's multi-language analysis

Kotlin Multiplatform test fixture.description: Sample KMP app fixture (Android, iOS, and shared modules) used to test Mason's multi-language analysis

Python Django test fixture.description: Sample Django project fixture used to test Mason's multi-language analysis

minimal Python test fixture.description: Minimal single-file Python project fixture used to test Mason's baseline analysis

Node React test fixture.description: Sample Node/React project fixture used to test Mason's multi-language analysis

Rust workspace test fixture.description: Sample Rust workspace fixture used to test Mason's multi-language analysis

test fixture path helper.description: Resolves absolute paths to fixture directories for tests

build tooling.description: Configures bundling of the six binary entry points, the Vitest test runner, and MCP bundle packaging.

AI context audit.description: Finds stale claims in repository instruction files with deterministic Git evidence. Decision-anchor advisories separately identify accepted revisions and pending proposals with their own provenance and changed anchors.

decision injection hook.description: Injects operative accepted decisions with separately labeled pending proposals and their freshness. Deduplicates per repository/session/revision and updates previously seen decisions after acceptance or retirement even when their anchors move.

diff review.description: Reviews committed diffs for absent historical co-change partners and touched decisions, keeping accepted and pending revision anchors distinct. Optional CI evidence retains provenance and advisory default exit codes with an explicit completeness gate.

safe repository file and metadata access.description: Shares canonical path checks, Git-aware file selection, sensitive-file exclusions, bounded reads, anchor matching, and atomic metadata replacement across Mason tools.

project onboarding.description: Returns read-only documentation audit and committed-diff findings, operative decision counts and pending proposal counts, and a short setup guide. Architecture mapping is optional and initialization markers do not gate tools.

decision review.description: Prepares the draft, operative accepted revision, and source evidence for both anchor sets. Authorized verdicts replace or withdraw the operative constraint, reject stale tokens, and preserve review history and baselines through metadata commits.

CI evidence review.description: Imports local Vitest JSON and SARIF artifacts with explicit outcome and provenance states. Findings stay associated with operative accepted anchors and owners while replacements are proposed; the test producer records actual exit status and checkout state.

drift check flow.description: Loads a validated map, computes relevant committed drift and live changes, and reports freshness separately from correctness verification.

decision staleness flow.description: Loads validated history, derives operative and pending revisions, and separately compares their anchors with committed and working-tree changes for context, review, audits, and hooks.

MCP server startup flow.description: Binary boots the MCP stdio server which registers all tool implementations

Confluence sync flow.description: Loads the snapshot, diffs against sync state, and pushes rendered pages to Confluence

get_context assembly flow.description: Loads decisions independently of the map, matches operative and pending revision text and anchors, and returns accepted constraints with separately labeled proposals, freshness, impact, and tests.

decision review flow.description: Prepares the raw draft and operative accepted revision with evidence for both anchor sets, validates the review token, and appends an authorized acceptance or retirement under a serialized write.

CI evidence review flow.description: Loads recorded test and analysis artifacts, preserves their outcome and freshness, links findings only to operative accepted decision anchors, and renders CLI/MCP review results with optional CI gating.
